prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling pottery workshop filled with natural light and earthy textures. On the left, an elderly woman with silver hair sits hunched over a spinning wheel, her hands coated in wet gray clay as she shapes a tall vase. Next to her, a young apprentice in a blue apron stands attentively, pointing at the rim of the vessel to suggest a refinement. In the center, a sturdy wooden table holds a large, unfinished terracotta bowl alongside a stack of white porcelain plates. To the right of the table, a man in a red scarf leans against the wall, looking at the apprentice with a critical eye while holding a sketchbook. Beside him, a small black cat sleeps curled up on a low stool, its tail twitching slightly. Near the back window, a child in yellow rain boots watches the scene, holding a small paintbrush. The elderly woman is handing a sponge to the apprentice, who reaches out to take it. There is no electricity visible in the room, suggesting a traditional manual process. The spatial arrangement places the active creation on the left, the observation on the right, and the finished works in the center, creating a balanced narrative of craft and learning within the rustic space.
